data.title: Precision measurements on the 138Ba+ 6s 2S1/2-5d 2D5/2 clock transition
data.authors: Arnold, K. J.; Kaewuam, R.; Chanu, S. R.; Tan, T. R.; Zhang, Z.; Barrett, M. D.
data.notes: Absolute frequency measurement of the 138Ba+ electric quadrupole 6s 2S1/2 - 5d 2D5/2 clock transition at ~1762 nm (170 THz). Phase-locked 1762 nm ECDL to optical frequency comb referenced to H-maser. Also determines Lande g_J factor for 5d 2D5/2 with 30-fold improvement. Frequency value from abstract of arXiv:1906.09150.

properties.notes: 138Ba+ has I=0 so no hyperfine structure. g_J(5D5/2) = 1.200367 39(24). Landé g factor for clock level.
Electric quadrupole 6s 2S1/2 - 5d 2D5/2 clock transition of 138Ba+. nu = 170126432449333.31(0.39)_stat(0.29)_sys Hz. Wavelength approximately 1762 nm.
